article.headline: Talford scores 20 as Winthrop defeats Gardner-Webb 96-93
article.description: — Kelton Talford scored 20 points as Winthrop beat Gardner-Webb 96-93 on Saturday.
article.linkText: Talford scores 20 as Winthrop defeats Gardner-Webb 96-93
article.story: ROCK HILL, S.C. -- — Kelton Talford scored 20 points as Winthrop beat Gardner-Webb 96-93 on Saturday. Talford also contributed nine rebounds for the Eagles (15-9, 5-4 Big South Conference). Kasen Harrison shot 5 of 10 from the field and 9 of 13 from the free-throw line to add 19 points. KJ Doucet and Nick Johnson both finished with 14 points. Darryl Simmons II led the way for the Runnin' Bulldogs (9-13, 4-5) with 40 points. Jamaine Mann added 20 points and seven rebounds for Gardner-Webb. Shahar Lazar also put up nine points. NEXT UP Winthrop's next game is Wednesday against Charleston Southern on the road, and Gardner-Webb visits UNC Asheville on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
